text:
```yaml
name: Validate Dotfiles Configuration

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v2
      with:
        node-version: '14'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        npm install -g shellcheck
        npm install -g fish-syntax-checker

    - name: Run shellcheck linting
      run: |
        shellcheck ./*.fish ./*.zsh

    - name: Run Fish syntax check
      run: |
        fish-syntax-checker ./*.fish

    - name: Run Zsh syntax check
      run: |
        zsh-syntax-highlighting --test ./*.zsh

    - name: Run shared configuration file integrity checks
      run: |
        ./scripts/check_shared_config.sh

    - name: Run generated abbreviation file consistency validation
      run: |
        ./scripts/check_abbreviations.sh

    - name: Run environment variable conflicts detection
      run: |
        ./scripts/check_env_vars.sh

    - name: Run symlink integrity verification (GNU Stow)
      run: |
        stow --dry-run .

    - name: Run required dependency availability checks
      run: |
        brew bundle check

    - name: Run Git function tests
      run: |
        ./scripts/test_git_functions.sh

    - name: Upload artifacts
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v2
      with:
        name: validation-report
        path: validation_report.txt
```
